signal: Lambda raised over $1.5B Series E in late 2025, signed a multibillion-dollar Microsoft GPU deal, and is targeting an IPO in H2 2026 as revenue nearly doubled.

email.body1:
Alex, saw Lambda close its $1.5B Series E, ink the Microsoft GPU deal, and set up for an H2 2026 IPO.

Growth and revenue moving that fast usually means more in-market commercial accounts than the team can cover before the next number lands. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your commercial motion off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alex, quick follow-up for Lambda.

Heading into an IPO, pipeline expectations climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your commercial team needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alex, last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other AI infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alex, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling commercial pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The pre-IPO stretch keeps the whole revenue org heads-down for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your commercial motion? I'll tailor it to Lambda either way.
